2609.24742.title: LLM-based Conversational AI Knowledge Assistant for MyBuddy Humanoid Robot
2609.24742.paper_summary: Humanoid robots are increasingly being popular and developed for human-centered applications, yet their ability to provide intelligent conversations and natural interactive knowledge assistance remains constrained by traditional rule-based dialogue systems, pre-defined responses and limited knowledge repositories. Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a powerful foundation for enabling natural, adaptive, and context-aware Human-Robot Interaction (HRI), which provides a significant opportunity to address such limitations by enabling robots to understand natural speech language, reason over complicated queries, maintain high-quality conversational context, and generate knowledge-rich responses. In this work, we originally present and implement an LLM-based versatile Conversational AI Knowledge Assistant for the Raspberry-Pi-powered 13-Axis MyBuddy humanoid robot, which integrates LLM-driven language understanding and AI reasoning with real-time speech recognition, knowledge retrieval via extensible access of internet engines (e.g., Wikipedia, arXiv), flexible dialogue management, and natural speech synthesis to enable much more intelligent multi-turn continuous conversations and advanced emotional-support Human-Robot Interaction.
2609.24742.paper_summary_zh: 人形機器人越來越受到歡迎，並且被開發用於以人為中心的應用，但它們提供智能對話和自然互動知識輔助的能力仍然受到傳統基於規則的對話系統、預定義的回應和有限知識庫的限制。大型語言模型（LLMs）已成為促進自然、自適應和上下文感知的人機互動（HRI）的強大基礎，這為解決這些限制提供了重要機會，使機器人能夠理解自然語言、對複雜查詢進行推理、保持高質量的對話上下文，並生成知識豐富的回應。在本研究中，我們首次提出並實現了一個基於LLM的多功能對話AI知識助手，該助手為搭載Raspberry-Pi的13軸MyBuddy人形機器人，整合了LLM驅動的語言理解和AI推理、實時語音識別、通過可擴展的網路引擎（例如，維基百科、arXiv）進行的知識檢索、靈活的對話管理以及自然語音合成，以實現更智能的多輪持續對話和先進的情感支持人機互動。
2609.24742.author: Hanxiao Chen et.al.
